title: Pull-apart garlic bread
creator: dr.vegan
yield: 24 pieces in a 23 × 13 cm loaf tin

items.note: plus up to ½ cup more if needed
plus about ½ cup to confit the garlic

steps: Dough: mix the warm milk, yeast and sugar, then the melted butter, salt and 2 cups (250 g) of flour. Knead 5–8 minutes until elastic, adding flour a spoon at a time only if needed.
Leave in an oiled, covered bowl somewhere warm for 60–90 minutes, until doubled.
Cover the garlic cloves with olive oil and bake covered at 160 °C for 45–60 minutes (or on the lowest heat on the stove for 30–40 minutes) until soft.
Mash the garlic with the soft butter and 1 tbsp of the garlic oil, then stir in the parsley, oregano, pepper, chilli flakes and salt to taste.
Grease and line the loaf tin. Divide the dough into 24 pieces, roll into balls, coat each in garlic butter, then in the Parmesan, and arrange loosely in two layers.
Cover and leave for 30–45 minutes until puffy, heating the oven to 175 °C.
Bake for 40–50 minutes until golden and cooked in the centre, covering with foil if it browns too fast.
Rest 10 minutes, lift out, sprinkle with parsley and serve warm.
notes: The creator lists 270 kcal per serving.
